entities.summary: Romeo Ashbey Crennel is an American former football coach. A long-time coaching assistant to Bill Parcells, Crennel served as the head coach of the Cleveland Browns from 2005 to 2008 and the Kansas City Chiefs in 2012, as well an assistant coach for six NFL teams and four collegiate teams. He has over 50 years of coaching experience, which included consistently being employed as a coach for all but two seasons since 1970 to 2021, only taking the 2009 and 2013 seasons off following both of his tenures as a permanent head coach.
